entities.summary: Shota Yasuda (b. 1984-09-11, Hyōgo Prefecture) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Hyōgo Prefecture and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
